## fastrcmdcheck

A drop-in, substantially faster alternative to rcmdcheck for continuous integration.

## Installation

Install with

```{r}
#| label: install
#| eval: false
remotes::install_github(
    repo = "grantn5/fastrcmdcheck"
  )
```
